system_overview: This is a utility module that defines a bitwise AND operator for natural numbers. It provides a pure-arithmetic implementation of bitwise AND using recursive decomposition of binary digits, along with support for a Java override class that can replace the pure implementation with a more efficient native version at model-checking time.
actors_and_components: There are no actors or processes. The module defines a single mathematical operator.
state_variables: NOT_SPECIFIED. This is a definitional module with no state variables or state transitions.
initial_state: NOT_SPECIFIED. This module defines no initial state.
actions: NOT_SPECIFIED. This module defines no actions or state transitions.
model_bounds: The operator works on natural numbers. Performance depends on the magnitude of the inputs since the recursive implementation processes one bit at a time.
additional_assumptions: The module can optionally be paired with a compiled Java class (Bits.class) that overrides the pure-arithmetic implementation with a native bitwise AND operation for better model-checking performance. The Java class must be compiled with the same Java version used by the model checker. If the Java override is not present, the pure recursive implementation is used, though it may cause errors if the result is compared with integers in certain contexts.
